name: Iffa Rameli
review: There are many gym equipments, and I’ve tried most of the machines. But there’s one missing the hip abductor machine. Hopefully boleh tambah. Overall, the gym is modern and comfortable.

name: Paveetra Ariv
review: I’ve never been someone who loves working out. But after trying a session with Coach Dev, I'm hooked! He makes every workout interesting and focuses on correct techniques. Highly recommended!

name: Thashiraa
review: The best value for money gym in Rawang in my opinion, very convenient, nice vibe and motivated environment. Definitely Everyone’s Home Gym.

name: Syahril Simon
review: Having a free trial. Very cozy and clean environment. Friendly gym crew. Everyone should come and try. You'll definitely like it.

name: Nur Julaiha
review: Tried this gym for the first time and honestly it’s so good! Super clean, good vibes, and really beginner-friendly. Love the atmosphere here. Definitely will come back.

name: Prasath
review: Awesome equipments and ambience. Very much clean.Helpfull staff. This gym is worth for every penny
